values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: 26 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/platteriver ('There are 26 sites for tent and small trailer use'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (26 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground on the Platte River under a hardwood canopy, ~2.5 mi SE of Honor via US-31 & Goose Rd (Benzie Co.), near the Platte River Hatchery; two mini cabins also on site. No posted max length; reviews describe large sites by the river, so a 23-ft rig fits. Trout and salmon fishing and paddling; ORVs may be ridden from the campsite to local ORV routes. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 26 sites, 15-day max (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Boilerplate 'tent and small trailer' wording, silent on length. Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORVs may ride from campsites to local ORV routes (not described as an ORV trail camp). Phone 231-276-9511 matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the DNR page says the campground 'is nestled along the majestic Platte River', 'is accessible by water' and 'is located along the Platte River'; the entry has 'not waterfront'.
